title: A Wonderful Family Reunion
blurb: Four years after running away, Zach is returned to his father John's mansion on Earth, and must find a way off the planet before he is shut away for good.

---

It was pure silence, Zach and John glaring at each other from opposite seats on the ship. So many things they wanted to say to each other, but didn't know where to start. To be honest, Zach would love nothing more than to just kill this man in front of him right now, but he knows he can’t harm a white hair on his head. He has more problems than the GU can throw at him, so he’ll just sulk at his own expense. He wonders if John wants to kill him… it *has* been 4 years….

“[Hey pilot! How much longer till we go back to Earth?]{John}” John yells at Sonichu, who Zach is sure is just loving this family drama.

“[Just a few more minutes, your *Excellency*…]{Sonichu}” the yellow bastard says with a smile. Zach knows it’s mocking, but John just sighs.

“[I need a drink…]{John}” he says, leaning his head in his hand.

“[And I need to get out of here.]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach states. John gives Zach the death glare that Zach has grown used to.

“[Shut up, Zacharias.]{John}” John deadpanned.

“[Make me, old man. The moment this ship lands, I’m out of here.]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[After your little stunt 4 years ago, what makes you think you’ll just waltz right back out?]{John}” John sneers.

“[Since when were you so insistent that I stayed in your presence?]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach challenged.

“[Since you left, all that I could think about was the numerous scandals that could occur! ‘Son of John Smith, delinquent?’, ‘Criminal turns out to be son of John Smith!’, ‘The Truth comes out. John Smith Abuse Allegations!’. My reputation is on the line and the last thing I need is my freak of an accident to be revealed to the public!]{John}” John vents. Zach scoffs.

“[Your reputation? Really? Last time I checked, since I left your reputation skyrocketed! For God’s sake, you got what you wanted! Why can’t you leave me alone for once!]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach sounds defeated, John smiles.

“[Because of how close I was to failure, due to me divorcing that bitch-]{John}” Zach grabs John’s lapel.

“[You have no right calling mom that! You were the reason she left and why I was stuck with you!]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach spat.

“[But the public doesn’t know that and it should stay that way.]{John}” John states. Zach raises his fist, John raises an eyebrow. “[You’re going to hit me? Hah! Go ahead! Just know I have the best lawyers.]{John}” Zach *really* wants to just clock him, right in the jaw, but he doesn’t. He lets go of John with a shove. John straightens out his suit jacket.

“[And here we are! Home sweet home! Have fun you two!]{Sonichu}” Sonichu says with enthusiasm. Zach is tired of everything that is happening. John nods.

“[Finally!]{John}” John says.

The ship lands just outside the mansion, the sun is setting. The hatch opens and the duo is greeted by three men in suits. They grab Zach and restrain him. “[Now then, when we land, you’ll be privately escorted to the most reserved part of the house. No windows, one way in, one way out, and only books and your thoughts to keep you entertained.]{John}”

“[I still don’t understand why I *must* still live with you if you want nothing to do with me…]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach says, a hint of confusion lacing his voice. John ignores this and just starts walking towards the mansion, with the men in suits dragging Zach along. They get into the foyer of the mansion when John stops, consequently causing the men in suits to stop behind him. John turns around and in a flash, punches Zach in the jaw. Zach makes no sound. John recomposes himself as he turns around again and takes a deep breath.

“[*That* was for running away. You may not understand what it’s like to be paranoid, but the moment a *single* leak about the *possibility* of you being related to me gets out, I’ll be ruined.]{John}” John says with no hesitation. “[Now then, take him to the room, and out of my sight.]{John}” The men in suits nod in unison before dragging Zach off.

4 days. 4 *days* of Zach being stuck in the room… he’s already read all the books twice. Every day, more men in suits came in to pin him as John came in after them and just hit Zach for no reason. His mental health seems to revert back to before he left. He ripped a strip off his bed sheets and used it as a blindfold, he doesn’t talk back as much anymore, using free paper sometimes to talk. He went to sleep on the 4th night, and he dreamt of his *real* family.

*Seth dancing with cartoon physics…*

*Vec blinking…*

*Dutch looking dangerous with Pauline…*

*Morra waving enthusiastically…*

*Zion looking tired, but attentive…*

*Bellow giving a soft smile…*

*Jack looking with nothing but love in his eyes…*

Zach wakes up with a start just as the door to the room opens, three men in suits walk in, with John following behind them, the suits grab Zach, but Zach isn’t having it.

Zach shoves them off and punches one in the face and kicks another in the stomach. They both crumple to the ground. The third pulls his gun but Zach grabs it out of his hand and aims at him. He puts his hand up in surrender. Zach gestures to the man to stand next to John, who hasn’t flinched once during the entire scuffle, with the gun. He does so and Zach takes a deep breath.

“[Now then, here’s what I’m going to do and you are *not* going to interfere. I’m going to get off this God-forsaken planet and never return again. Because quite frankly, there’s no reason to stay here.]{Zacharias Smith}” John is about to interrupt but Zach just tightens his grip on the gun. “[Let me lay down the facts. I’ve been gone for *four* years. And in those four years you have gotten onto the GU Council, giving you more influential power and a fanbase who *adore* you. I have found a group that is more of a family than you ever could be. They let me be myself and if you haven’t noticed, my eyes and my voice are no longer hidden. And I *love* it that way. Hell, I found myself the greatest man out there and he doesn’t *care* why I hide my eyes or not talk. But now he thinks I’m dead because I got stuck with *you*. And in *all* that time, *no one* has questioned my family history and even if they did, no one would believe me. Now then, you are going to let me ‘waltz out of here’ and trust me, you won’t ever hear from me ever again.]{Zacharias Smith}” His voice is hoarse from not using it for a while. John just looks at Zach with no emotion. After several minutes John finally spoke.

“[You have until sunrise to get off this planet. And if my men even *speculate* that you are still here, any hope of you leaving that room is *gone*.]{John}” he threatened, but Zach wasn’t fazed. He just points the gun at the man in the suit, who makes a sound of fear.

“[Phone. *Now*.]{Zacharias Smith}” The man doesn’t hesitate before tossing his phone to Zach who catches it with his free hand. He then tosses the gun to the ground before turning around and leaving the mansion, not even sparing a last glance to John.

***

(The rest of this one-shot is just ZachxJack fluff so read if you want to I guess...)

***

Zach gets to the transit station, the very same where he met his first crew, when he sees the advertisement board, he scans it before seeing what he’s looking for.

*Free Handed Trading Company*

Zach calls the number, hoping he will answer. After a few rings a male voice rings out.

“[Free Handed Trading Company, the only company that will move things without questioning its legality. Jack speaking.]{Jack Madison}”

Zach could cry at Jack’s voice alone… but then he realizes that Jack has never heard his voice before. Will Jack recognize him? Will he believe him?

“[Hello?]{Jack Madison}” Jack’s voice snaps Zach out of his thoughts.

“[O-Oh! Sorry, um… I have a question?]{Zacharias Smith}” God, why does he sound so *nervous*?

“[Sure! What’s your question?]{Jack Madison}”

“[I… I was wondering what the charge is for transporting someone off a planet…]{Zacharias Smith}” There was silence from Jack’s end. Zach’s stomach drops. He checks outside, *there’s not much time left!*

“[It’s a hefty charge, since it is a *person* after all, even more so if they’re unconscious or unable to consent. We might not question legality here, but we *do* have morals sir…]{Jack Madison}” Jack seems wary of Zach, who is trying to come up with ways to deescalate the situation.

“[The person in question is me actually…]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach admits.

“[Sir… we aren’t a taxi service…]{Jack Madison}”

“[I know that, but I need to get off this planet as fast as possible, so *please*…]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach knows he’s getting desperate, but it’s justified!

“[*Sigh* fine… just because I’m the one on the phone, so be lucky!]{Jack Madison}” Jack huffs. Zach swears that if Jack knew who was on the phone, he would’ve proposed right then and there.

“[Thank you so much! Can I request a specific person?]{Zacharias Smith}” More silence on the phone.

“[I guess if you knew anyone in the company.]{Jack Madison}” Jack sounds confused.

“[Then I request Jack Madison.]{Zacharias Smith}” There’s noise of things hitting the floor on Jack’s side. Zach chuckles knowing he surprised him. It takes a minute for the noise to subside and for Jack to recompose himself.

“[W-What’s your name a-and what planet are you on sir?]{Jack Madison}” Jack is spooked.

“[I’m on the planet Earth and my name… is Zach.]{Zacharias Smith}” More silence on the phone. Another minute passes before Zach swears he heard a soft “[no]{Jack Madison}” on the phone.

“[I-I’ll be at the station in an hour… does that work?]{Jack Madison}” Zach is sure Jack is shaking. He checks outside, it’s definitely brighter, but he has at least 2 hours left.

“[Yeah… yeah that works…]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[See you then…]{Jack Madison}” *click* Zach releases a breath he didn’t know he was holding…

***

An hour passes and it’s almost light outside, Zach is pacing outside the station. He doesn’t know if John’s men are watching him, just waiting for their moment to grab Zach and take him back to the mansion. Zach doesn’t want to go back, he wasn’t *supposed* to go back. But here he is! Stuck on Earth with an hour left of freedom, with a boyfriend who is in disbelief that his boyfriend is calling for help, and a crew who is probably freezing to death on a planet that he doesn’t know the name of. *Fuck* he hopes they’re surviving…

A phone ringing interrupts his thoughts, he answers.

“[H-Hello?]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Hey! This is Jack, from the company?]{Jack Madison}”

“[O-Oh! Right, yes… I’m assuming you’re here?]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Y-yeah, I’m at terminal two.]{Jack Madison}”

“[Great! I’ll be there in a second.]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Ok!]{Jack Madison}” *click*

Zach walks over to terminal 2, his palms are sweaty. He has to face Jack without his hood on, after all, Bellow is still using it to keep warm… hopefully.

The sound of the hatch opening rings through the terminal, Zach holds his breath, why was he so nervous? It’s only Jack… who is currently giving him a look of suspicion… and has his hand on the grip of his holstered laser pistol…

“[So… you’re Zach?]{Jack Madison}” Jack asks, still firmly gripping the holster.

“[Yes I am… shall we get going?]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach says, releasing the breath he was holding.

“[You stay in the cargo hold, once we get off this planet I’m dropping you off at the nearest outpost, understand?]{Jack Madison}” Zach nods and walks onto the ship, taking a seat in the cargo hold. Jack raises an eyebrow at just how compliant Zach was, then again the bruises on his face are a telltale sign that he wants *off*. But a job’s a job so he follows and walks past Zach to the cockpit.

The ship lifts off and exits Earth’s orbit, Zach relaxes, he made it! No more John, no more abuse, no more hiding… Zach leans his head back and closes his eyes.

Jack can barely focus on the open space in front of him, the guy in his cargo hold is on the forefront of his mind. He doesn’t know exactly why though! Maybe it’s the fact that this guy reminds him of someone, it’s so *uncanny*. The look, the mannerisms, hell even the fact that his name is Zach is just too much of a coincidence. But even then that just brings more questions! Why does he have bruises? What made him come back? Why did he want to leave so quickly? What happened to his crew? Are they dead? *What in the actual hell is going on?*

Jack grunts in frustration before putting the ship on autopilot. He gets up from the pilot’s seat and grabs a first aid kit and an ice pack… this wasn’t his first time escorting an abuse victim… and walks down to the cargo hold. He pauses when he sees Zach. He looked so… peaceful, even with the bruises and cuts, he looked not bothered… *just how long has this been going on*?

“[You know staring is rude, I may be blindfolded, but I can still see just fine.]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach says, looking in Jack’s direction. Jack flinches.

“[S-sorry… um, I got some stuff for your cuts… I only got one ice pack though… so…]{Jack Madison}” Jack is fumbling through his words, Zach chuckles.

“[Thanks, as much as I would do it myself there’s no mirror here… mind helping me?]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach inquires. Jack squints. *Is he really serious?*

“[You look… confused. You ok?]{Zacharias Smith}” Jack sighs.

“[Ok I’m going to go insane. Have we met before?]{Jack Madison}” Jack asks. Zach smiles before laughing. Jack pouts. “[I’m serious! Why do you seem so *familiar*?]{Jack Madison}” Zach laughs harder, leaving Jack even more confused.

A minute passes before Zach calms down, his smile still present. He stands up. “[‘I’d never forget a face like that’, guess you did!]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Zach?]{Jack Madison}”

A nod.

A beat of silence.

“[Zach!!!]{Jack Madison}” Jack scoops him for a hug.

“[Owowowow still injured Jack!]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach yells.

“[Oh Jesus sorry!]{Jack Madison}” Jack sets him down. “[Right, totally forgot about that, let’s get that taken care of.]{Jack Madison}” Zach nods and sits back down. Jack hands the ice pack to Zach. “[Just put this on the worst one.]{Jack Madison}” Zach puts it on his jaw. Jack then opens the first aid kit and gets to work disinfecting the cuts and bandaging them. The entire scene is very domestic and it makes Zach happy… he could get used to this.

“[Hey Zach…]{Jack Madison}” Jack says softly.

“[Hm?]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[There’s a cut that goes underneath the blindfold…]{Jack Madison}” Zach stiffens. “[I can skip over this one and let you do this! I know that you don’t like showing your eyes and-]{Jack Madison}”

“[Go ahead…]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach interrupts.

“[I-I’m sorry?]{Jack Madison}”

“[I said go ahead…]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[You sure?]{Jack Madison}”

“[It isn’t as romantic as I wanted it… but I’ve learned that I shouldn’t hide forever, so here.]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach reaches for the knot of the blindfold and loosens it. Jack holds his breath. Zach then takes off the blindfold.

Jack can see the Big Dipper.

“[Beautiful…]{Jack Madison}” Jack says in a whisper. Zach looks surprised. Jack realizes what he said and blushes. Zach starts to tear up. Jack gets concerned. “[Hey hey! What’s wrong?]{Jack Madison}”

“[Sorry… just never heard that about my eyes before…]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[But it’s true though! I’ve heard the phrase ‘stars in your eyes’ but this is incredible!]{Jack Madison}” Jack says excitedly. Zach lets a tear fall before giving out a breathy laugh.

“[T-thanks…]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Now that I get to see the rest of your beautiful face, can I finish with these cuts?]{Jack Madison}” Zach chuckles before lightly shoving Jack.

“[I forgot how suave you are!]{Zacharias Smith}”

***

After Zach was treated, the two took the time to catch up. Talking about what has happened, more specifically what has happened to Zach and his crew… wait…

“[OH MY GOD! They must be worried and freezing and…]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Woahwoahwoah, hey calm down. What happened?]{Jack Madison}” Jack asks.

“[I was… separated from them on an ice planet, our ship was destroyed, and we encountered some enemies and…]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach is stressed out. Jack is trying his best to calm him down, but to no avail. Zach is racking his brain for some idea on how to get to them, some kinda way to talk to them…

“[*Gasp* Jack! I left my phone with them!]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Is that why I couldn’t get a hold of you?]{Jack Madison}”

“[Yeah… when I got kidnapped-]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Kidnapped?!]{Jack Madison}”

“[Long story! Anyway I dropped my sword and phone when I was taken! Maybe I can get a hold of them that way! Jack, can I have your phone real quick?]{Zacharias Smith}” Jack looks downcast as he hands his phone to Zach.

“[I guess it wouldn’t hurt to try…]{Jack Madison}”

“[Hey… what’s wrong?]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[It’s just that… I want to spend more time with you, but you got this ‘secret mission’ and all so I won’t get in the way…]{Jack Madison}” Zach opens his mouth to say something but closes it. Jack does have a point… Zach thinks for a bit before getting an idea. He opens a music app and plays slow music. Jack looks at him incredulously.

“[What are you doing?]{Jack Madison}”

“[You said you wanted to spend time together… so let’s dance.]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach suggests with a shrug.

“[Do you even know how to dance?]{Jack Madison}” Jack says with a smile.

“[We could just hold each other and sway…]{Zacharias Smith}”

Jack considers it for a second before nodding, standing up and offering his hand, Zach takes it and the two embrace each other and sway. They close their eyes and just let the music take over the space. Zach knows he needs to call the crew, but right now…

He wants to spend time with his boyfriend.
